spans.s:
अधि 1. अधि, इस्, m. (better आधि, q. v.),
anxiety, perplexity; f. a woman in her courses.

अधि 2. अधि, ind., as a prefix to verbs and
nouns, expresses above, over and above, besides.
As a separable adverb or preposition; (with abl.)
Ved. over; from above; from; from the presence of;
for; (with gen.) Ved. among; (with loc.) Ved.
over; on; at; subject to; (with acc.) over, upon,
concerning.
—अध्य्-अधि, ind. on high, just above.

अधी अधी (अधि-इ), cl. 2. P. अध्य्-एति, -तुम्,
to meet with, attain, notice, observe, understand; to
mind, remember, care for, long for; to know, know
by heart; to go over; study, learn, read, recite, de-
clare; A. अधीते, to study, learn by heart, read,
recite, declare: Caus. P. अध्य्-आपयति, -यितुम्, to
make one read or study, teach, instruct; Desid. of the
Caus. अध्य्-आपिपयिषति, to be desirous of teaching:
Desid. अधीषिषति, to be desirous of teaching.

1. आ-धि, इस्, m. (for 2. आ-धि see under आ-ध्यै),
place, situation; a pledge, deposit; a pawn, a mort-
gage; location fixing, site; definition, epithet.
—आ-
धि-त्व, अम्, n. the nature or circumstance of a
pledge.
—आधित्वोपाधि (˚त्व-उप्˚), इस्, m. the ob-
ject or purpose with which a pledge is given, the
conditions or terms of a mortgage.
—आधि-भोग,
अस्, m. enjoyment or use of a deposit, use of a horse,
cow, &c., when pledged.

आधि आ-धि. See under आ-धा above for
1. आ-धि, and under आ-ध्यै for 2. आ-धि.

2. आ-धि, इस्, m. (for 1. see under आ-धा), thought,
care, anxious reflection, mental agony, anxiety, pain;
misfortune; reflection on religion or duty; hope, ex-
pectation; a man solicitous for his family's livelihood.
—आधि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by pain, &c.
—आधि-
ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering pain, distressed; crooked.
—आधि-मन्यु, अवस्, m. pl. feverish heat or burning.
—आधि-म्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, withered with anxiety.

आ-धी, f., Ved. thinking, longing, care.
—आधी-
पर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. winged with longing or
hope.

अधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, additional; subsequent, later;
surpassing (in number or quantity or quality), superior,
more numerous; abundant; excellent; supernumerary,
redundant; secondary, inferior; intercalated; (अम्),
n. surplus; abundance; redundancy; hyperbole: ind.
exceedingly; too much; more.
—अधिकं-तु, more-
over.
—अधिक-क्षय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing
excessive waste.
—अधिक-ता, f. or अधिक-त्व,
अम्, n. addition, excess, redundancy, preponderance.
—अधिक-तिथि, इस्, m. f. an intercalary lunar day.
—अधिक-दन्त or अधि-दन्त, अस्, m. a redun-
dant tooth which grows over another.
—अधिक-दिन
or अधि-दिन, अम्, n. an intercalated day.
—अधिक-
मांसार्मन् (˚स-अर्˚), अ, n. proud flesh in the eye;
see अधिमांस.
—अधिक-मास, अस्, m. an inter-
calated month.
—अधिकर्द्धि (˚क-ऋद्˚), इस्, इस्, इ,
abundantly prosperous.
—अधिक-वाक्योक्ति (˚क्य-
उक्˚), इस्, f. exaggeration, hyperbole.
—अधिक-षा-
ष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (containing or costing) more than
sixty.
—अधिक-संवत्सर, अस्, m. an intercalated
month.
—अधिक-साप्ततिक, अस्, ई, अम् (containing or
costing) more than seventy.
—अधिकाङ्ग (˚क-अङ्˚),
अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, having some redundant member or
members; (अम्), n. belt worn over the coat of mail.
—अधिकाधिक (˚ख-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, outdoing
one another.
—अधिकार्थ (˚क-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
exaggerated.
—अधिकार्थ-वचन, अम्, n. exagger-
ation, hyperbole,

अधिकर्मकर अधि-कर्मकर, अस्, m. or
अधि-कर्मकृत्, त्, m. an overseer of workmen.

अधिकल्पिन् अधि-कल्पिन्, ई, m., Ved. a
sharp gambler.

अधिकार्म अधि-कार्म, अम्, n., N. of some
place unknown.

अधिकृ अधि-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
to place at the head, appoint; to aim at, regard;
to refer or allude to; to superintend, be at the head
of: A. -कुरुते, to be or become entitled to; to be
or become superior to.

आधी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to pledge,
mortgage. pawn, make a deposit.

अधि-करण, अम्, n. the act of placing at the
head or of subordinating government, supremacy,
magistracy, court of justice; a receptacle, sup-
port; a claim; a topic, subject; (in philosophy) a
[]
substratum; a subject (e. g. आत्मा is the अधि-करण
of knowledge); a category; a relation; (in grammar)
regimen, government, comprehension, location, the
sense of the locative case; relationship of words in a
sentence, which agree together, either as adjective and
substantive, or as subject and predicate, or as two sub-
stantives in apposition; (in rhetoric) a topic; a para-
graph or minor section; (अस्, ई), m. f. one who has to
superintend.
—अधिकरण-भोजक, अस्, m. a judge.
—अधिकरण-मण्डप, अस्, अम्, m. n. the hall
of justice.
—अधिकरण-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. a syl-
logism or conclusion which involves others.
—अधि-
करणैतावत्त्व (˚ण-एत्˚), अम्, n. fixed quantity of
a substratum.
आधी-करण, अम्, n. pledging, mortgaging, a pledge.

अधि-करणिक or better आधिकरणिक, अस्, m.
a government official; a judge or magistrate.
अधि-करण्य, अम्, n. authority, power.

आधिकारण्य आधिकारण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अधि-
करण्य), possession, location.

अधि-कर्मन्, अ, n. superintendence.
—अधि-
कर्मकृत् or अधि-कर्मकर, see s. v.
—अधि-
कर्म-कृत, अस्, m. person appointed to superin-
tend an establishment.
अधिकर्मिक, अस्, m. the overseer of a market.

अधि-कार, अस्, m. authority; office; government,
rule, administration, jurisdiction; royalty, prerogative;
title; rank; claim, right, especially to perform sacri-
fices with benefit; privilege; ownership; possession;
property; reference, relation; exertion, effort; a topic,
subject; a paragraph or minor section; (in grammar)
government; a heading-rule; (अस्, ई), m. f. having
much to superintend.
—अधिकार-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
established in an office.
—अधिकाराढ्य (˚र-आढ˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, invested with authority.
अधीकार अधी-कार = अधि-कार, q. v.

अधि-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, possessing authority; en-
titled to; fit for; (ई), m. a superintendent, governor;
an official; a rightful claimant; a proprietor, master;
one possessing the right of sacrificing; a man pro-
ficient in the Vedānta; man as the lord of creation.
—अधिकारि-त्व, अम्, n. or अधिकारि-ता, f. author-
ity; rightful claim; ownership, &c.

अधि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, placed at the head of;
appointed; ruled, administered; claimed; (अस्), m.
a superintendent, especially a comptroller of public
accounts.
—अधिकृत-त्व, अम्, n. the being engaged
in or occupied with.
आधी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pledged. pawned, mortgaged.
अधि-कृति, इस्, f. a right, privilege; possession.

अधि-कृत्य, ind. having placed at the head, having
made the chief subject; regarding; concerning; with
reference to.
आधी-कृत्य, ind. having pledged, mortgaged, &c.

अधिक्रम् अधि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति,
-क्रमितुम्, to ascend, mount up to; to attack, scale.
अधि-क्रम, अस्, m. an invasion, attack.
अधि-क्रमण, अम्, n. act of invading or scaling.

अधिक्षि अधि-क्षि, cl. 6. or cl. 1. P., Ved.
-क्षियति or -क्षेति, -क्षेतुम्, to be settled in or
over, rest upon; to inhabit, to obtain; (occasionally
अधि-क्षिप् occurs for this rt. by mistake.)

अधिक्षित् अधि-क्षित्, त्, m., Ved. a lord,
ruler (fr. rt. 2. क्षि and not fr. अधि-क्षि above).

अधिक्षिप् अधि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. -क्षिपति,
-क्षेप्तुम्, to lay upon; to bespatter; to insult, abuse,
scold; to superinduce (disease); (occasionally this rt.
appears to be used by mistake for अधि-क्षि, q. v.)

अधिक्षिपद्-अब्ज-नेत्र, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, having
eyes which eclipse the lotus.

अधि-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, insulted; scolded;
thrown down; placed, fixed; despatched.
अधि-क्षेप, अस्, m. abuse, contempt; dismissal.

अधिगण् अधि-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति,
-यितुम्, to enumerate, to value highly.

अधिगम् अधि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति,
-गन्तुम्, to go up to, approach, overtake; to have
sexual intercourse with; to fall in with; to meet,
find, discover, obtain; to accomplish; to study, read:
Desid. P. अधि-जिगमिषति, to seek; A. अधि-
जिगांसते, to be desirous of studying or reading.

अधि-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, found, obtained, acquired;
gone, over, studied, learnt.
अधि-गन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attainable.
अधि-गन्तृ, त्, आ, m. one who attains or acquires.

अधि-गम, अस्, m. the act of attaining, acquisi-
tion; acquirement, mastery, study, knowledge; mer-
cantile return, profit, &c.

अधि-गमन, अम्, n. acquisition; finding; ac-
quirement, reading, study; marriage, copulation.

अधि-गमनीय or अधि-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
attainable, practicable to be learnt.

अधिगर्त्य अधि-गर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
(found) on the driver's seat.

अधिगव अधि-गव, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (found)
on or in a cow, derived from a cow.

अधिगा अधि-गा, cl. 2. P. A. or cl. 3. P.
-गाति, -ते, -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to fall in with, obtain; to
notice, to go over, learn, read, study, remember;
to attempt, resolve: Caus. P. अधि-गापयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to go over or teach: Desid. of the Caus.
अधि-जिगापयिषति, to be desirous of teaching.

अधिगुण अधि-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
superior qualities.

अधिगुप्त अधि-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, protected,
guarded.

अधिचङ्क्रम अधि-चङ्क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
walking or creeping over something.

अधिचर् अधि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्,
to walk or move on or over something.

अधि-चरण, अम्, n. the act of walking or mov-
ing or being on or over something.

अधिचि अधि-चि, cl. 5. P. -चिनोति, -चेतुम्,
to pile or build upon.

अधिजन् अधि-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्,
to be born.
अधि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born, superior by birth.
अधि-जनन, अम्, n. birth.
अधिजानु अधि-जानु, ind. on the knees.

अधिजि अधि-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to
win in addition, conquer.

अधिजिह्व अधि-जिह्व, अस्, m. or अधि-
जिह्विका, f. a peculiar swelling of the tongue or
epiglottis.

अधिज्य अधि-ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
bowstring (ज्या) up or stretched, i. e. strung.

अधिज्योतिषम् अधि-ज्योतिषम्, ind. on the
subject of light or the mundane luminaries (a chapter
in the Upaniṣads).
अधितिष्ठति अधि-तिष्ठति. See अधिष्ठा।

अधित्य अधित्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अधि), being
above.
अधीत्य, ind. having gone over, having studied.

अधित्यका, f. land on the upper part of a moun-
tain, table land.

अधिदण्डनेतृ अधि-दण्ड-नेतृ, ता, m. (ruler
appointed to punish), epithet of Yama.

अधिदन्त अधि-दन्त, अस्, m. a redundant
tooth which grows over another.

अधिदार्व अधि-दार्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दारु),
wooden.

अधिदिन अधि-दिन, अम्, n. an intercalated
day.

अधिदेव अधि-देव, अस्, m. or अधि-देवता,
f. a presiding or tutelary deity.
—अधि-देवम् or
अधि-देवतम्, ind. concerning the gods or the deity.

अधिदेवन अधि-देवन, अम्, n., Ved. part of
the house allotted to gambling; the table or board
for gambling.

अधिदैव अधि-दैव or अधि-दैवत, अम्, n,
a presiding or tutelary deity; the supreme deity; the
[]
divine agent operating in material objects.
—अधि-
दैवम् or अधिदैवतम्, ind. on the subject of
the deity or the divine agent.
अधि-दैविक, अस्, ई, अम्, spiritual.

आधिदैविक आधिदैविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अधि-
देव), relating to a tutelary or presiding deity.

आधिदैविक; add — proceeding from the influence
of the atmosphere or planets, proceeding from divine
or supernatural agencies.

अधिधा अधि-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति, -धातुम्,
to give, present; A. -धत्ते, to acquire additionally.

अधिधृ अधि-धृ, Caus. P. -धारयति,
-यितुम्, to carry over or across.

अधिनाथ अधि-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of the
author of the Kālayoga-śāstra.
अधि-नाथ; add — a supreme lord, chieftain.

अधिनिधा अधि-नि-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति,
-धातुम्, to deposit, impart.
अधिनिर्णिज् अधि-निर्णिज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. veiled.

अधिनिवस् अधि-नि-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति,
-वस्तुम्, to dwell.

अधिनी अधि-नी, cl. 1. P. -नयति, -नेतुम्,
to lead away from (with abl.); to raise above the
ordinary measure, enhance.

अधिनृत् अधि-नृत्, cl. 4. P. -नृत्यति,
-नर्तितुम्, to dance upon (with acc.).

अधिप अधि-प, अस्, m. a ruler, commander,
regent, king.
अधि-पा, आस्, m., Ved. a ruler, king, sovereign.

अधि-पति, इस्, m. same as अधि-प, (in medic.)
a particular part of the head, where a wound proves
instantly fatal.
—अधिपति-वती, f., Ved., N. given to
certain female divinities.
अधि-पत्नी, f. a female sovereign or ruler.

अधिपथम् अधि-पथम्, ind. over or across
a road.

अधिपांशुल अधि-पांशुल, अस्, आ, अम्, become
dusty from above; dusty. Also अधि-पांसुल.

अधिपुरुष अधि-पुरुष, अस्, m. the su-
preme spirit.

अधिपू अधि-पू, cl. 9. P., Ved. -पुनाति,
-पवितुम्, to besprinkle, to sprinkle.

अधिपूतभृतम् अधि-पूत-भृतम्, ind., Ved.
over the (vessel) full of purified Soma.

अधिपेषण अधि-पेषण, अस्, आ, अम्, serving
to pound or grind upon.

अधिप्रजम् अधि-प्रजम्, ind. on the subject
of procreation as a means of preserving the world (a
chapter in the Upaniṣads).

अधिप्रष्टियुग अधि-प्रष्टि-युग, अम्, n. yoke
laid upon the प्रष्टि or foremost of three horses,
used on certain sacrificial occasions, to which a fourth
horse could be attached; (अस्), m. the fourth horse
thus attached (?).

अधिबाध् अधि-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते,
-धितुम्, to vex, annoy.

अधिब्रू अधि-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति, -वक्तुम्,
to give orders to.

अधिभुज् अधि-भुज्, cl. 7. A. -भुङ्क्ते,
-भोक्तुम्, to enjoy.

अधिभू अधि-भू, ऊस्, m. (rt. भू with अधि),
a master, a superior.

अधि-भूत, अम्, n. the spiritual or fine substratum
of material or gross objects; the all-penetrating in-
fluence of the supreme spirit; the supreme spirit
himself; nature.
—अधि-भूतम्, ind. on the subject
of material objects (a chapter in the Upainṣads).

अधि-भौतिक (better आधिभौतिक, q. v.), अस्,
ई, अम्, natural (?).

आधिभौतिक आधिभौतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
अधि-भूत), relating to beings; elementary, derived
or produced from the primitive elements, material.

अधिभोजन अधि-भोजन, अम्, n. an addi-
tional gift.

अधिमन्थ अधि-मन्थ or अधी-मन्थ, अस्,
m. (churning of the eyes), severe ophthalmia.
अधीमन्थ अधी-मन्थ = अधि-मन्थ, q. v.

अधि-मन्थन, अम्, n., Ved. friction for pro-
ducing fire; (अस्, आ, अम्), suitable for such friction
(as wood).

अधि-मन्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering from oph-
thalmia.

अधिमांस अधि-मांस or अधि-मांसक, अस्,
m. proud flesh or cancer, especially in the eyes or
the back part of the gums.
—अधिमांसार्मन् (˚स-
अर्˚), अ, n. ophthalmic disease produced by proud
flesh or cancer.

अधिमात्र अधि-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, past or
above measure, excessive; (अम्), ind. on the subject
of prosody.
—अधिमात्र-कारुणिक, अस्, m. (ex-
ceedingly merciful), N. of a Mahā-brāhmaṇa among
the Buddhists.

अधिमास अधि-मास, अस्, m. an intercalary
month.

अधिमुक्ति अधि-मुक्ति, इस्, f. (with Buddhists)
intuition (?); implicit faith (?).
—अधिमुक्ति-सार,
अस्, आ, अम्, wholly given to intuition or to implicit
faith (?).

अधि-मुक्तिक, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) an epi-
thet of Mahā-kāla.

अधिमुह्य अधि-मुह्य, अस्, m., N. of Śākya-
muni in one of his thirty-four former births.

अधियज्ञ अधि-यज्ञ, अस्, m. the chief or
principal sacrifice; influence or agency affecting a
sacrifice; (अस्, आ, अम्), relating to a sacrifice; (अम्),
ind. on the subject of sacrifices.

अधियत् अधि-यत्, cl. 1. A., Ved. -यतते,
-तितुम्, to fasten, fix, stick.
अधीयत्, अन्, अती, अत्, remembering, proficient study.

अधियम् अधि-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति,
-यन्तुम्, to give, present.

अधिया अधि-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to
escape.

अधियाङ्ग अधियाङ्ग, अम्, n. a redundant
limb; (better अधिकाङ्ग.)

अधियोध अधि-योध, अस्, m. a warrior who
fights in the first lines (?).

अधिरज्जु अधि-रज्जु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. carrying
a rope, fastening, fettering.

अधिरथ अधि-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, being upon
or over a car; (अस्), m. a charioteer; N. of a
charioteer who was a prince of Aṅga and Karṇa's
foster-father; (अम्), n. a cart-load.

अधि-रथि, इस्, m. (various reading for उद-रथि),
the sun (?); the sea (?).
अधि-रथ्यम्, ind. on the high road.

अधिराज् अधि-राज्, ट्, m. a supreme king,
emperor.
अधि-राज, अस्, or अधि-राजन्, आ, m. an emperor.

अधि-राज्य or अधि-राष्ट्र, अम्, n. supremacy,
imperial dignity; an empire; N. of a country.
—अधिराज्य-भाज्, क्, m. possessor of imperial dig-
nity.

आधिराज्य आधिराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. अधि-राजन्),
royalty, royal government, supreme sway.

अधिरुक्म अधि-रुक्म, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing
gold.

अधिरुह् अधि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. or poet. A.
अधि-रोहति, -ते, -रोढुम्, to rise above, to ascend,
mount: Caus. -रोपयति, -यितुम्, to raise, place above.
अधि-रुह्; add — to attack, accuse.

अधि-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, ascended, mounted.
—अधिरूढ-समाधि-योग, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged
in profound meditation.

अधि-रोपण, अम्, n. the act of raising or causing
to mount.
अधि-रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, placed above.
अधि-रोह, अस्, m. ascent, mounting, overtopping.

अधि-रोहण, अम्, n. act of ascending or mounting
or rising above; (ई), f. a ladder, flight of steps.

अधि-रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rising above, ascending, &c.;
(इणी), f. a ladder, flight of steps.

अधिलोकम् अधि-लोकम्, ind. on the subject
[]
of the universe (a chapter in the Upaniṣads).
—अधि-
लोक-नाथ, अस्, m. lord of the universe.

अधिवच् अधि-वच्, cl. 2. P., Ved. -वक्ति, -वक्-
तुम्, to speak in favour of; to advocate; to side with.

अधि-वक्तृ, ता, m., Ved. an advocate; a com-
forter; an orator.

अधि-वचन, अम्, n. advocacy; speaking in favour
of; an appellation, epithet.
अधि-वाक, अस्, m., Ved. advocacy, protection.

अधिवप् अधि-वप्, cl. 1. A., Ved. -वपते,
-वप्तुम्, to put on; to shatter.

अधिवस् 1. अधि-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति,
-वस्तुम्, to inhabit; to settle or perch upon.

अधिवस् 2. अधि-वस्, cl. 2. A. -वस्ते,
-वसितुम्, to put on or over (as clothes &c.).

अधिवास् अधि-वास्, cl. 10. P. -वासयति,
-यितुम्, to scent, perfume.

1. अधि-वास, अस्, m. an inhabitant, a neighbour;
one who dwells above; a habitation, abode, settle-
ment, site; sitting before a person's house without
taking food till he ceases to oppose or refuse a demand,
commonly called ‘sitting in dharṇā;’ pertinacity; (for
2. 3. अधि-वास, see below.)
—अधिवास-भूमि, इस्,
f. a dwelling-place, settlement.

2. अधि-वास or अधी-वास, अस्, m. an upper gar-
ment, mantle.

3. अधि-वास, अस्, m. application of perfumes or
fragrant cosmetics. (
For. 1. 2
. अधि-वास, see above.)

3. अधि-वास; add — fumigation of a person or
image with incense, &c.; fragrance, perfume; smell,
odour (in general).
अधीवास अधी-वास = अधि-वास, q. v.

1. अधि-वासन, अम्, n. act of causing the divinity
to take up its abode in an image; sitting in dharṇā
[cf. s. v. अधि-वास above]. (For 2. अधि-वासन,
see below.)

2. अधि-वासन, अम्, n. application of perfumes,
&c.; touching a vessel containing fragrant objects, that
have been presented to an idol, as a ceremony; pre-
liminary purification of the image.

अधि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inhabiting, settled in.
—अधिवासि-ता, f. settled residence.
अधि-वस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, clothed.

1. अधि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, invested with, clothed
with; see also s. v. अधि-वास् below.
2. अधि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, scented.

अधिवाज्य अधि-वाज्य, अम्, n., N. of a
country; correctly अधि-राज्य.

अधिवाहन अधि-वाहन, अस्, m., N. of a
man, said to be a son of Aṅga.

अधिविकर्तन अधि-वि-कर्तन, अम्, n. the
act of cutting off.

अधिविक्रम् अधि-वि-क्रम्, cl. 1. A. -क्रमते,
-मितुम्, to step forth towards or for some one.

अधिविद् अधि-विद्, cl. 6. P. -विन्दति,
-वेदितुम्, to obtain; to marry in addition to.

अधि-विन्ना, f. a wife whose husband has married
again; a neglected or superseded wife.

अधि-वेत्तव्या or अधि-वेदनीया or अधि-वेद्या,
f. a wife in addition to whom it is proper to marry
another.

अधि-वेत्तृ, ता, m. a husband who marries an
additional wife.
अधि-वेदन, अम्, n. marrying an additional wife.

अधिविद्यम् अधि-विद्यम्, ind. on the sub-
ject of science (a chapter in the Upaniṣads).

अधिवेदम् अधि-वेदम्, ind. concerning the
Veda.

अधिशी अधि-शी, cl. 2. A. -शेते, -शयितुम्,
to lie down upon, to lie upon, to sleep upon.
अधि-शयन, अस्, आ, अम्, lying on, sleeping on.

अधि-शयित, अस्, आ, अम्, recumbent upon; used
for lying or sleeping upon.

अधिश्रि अधि-श्रि, cl. 1. P. -श्रयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. -श्रयितवै, to ascend; to put on fire, make hot.

अधि-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, having great prosperity, highly
prosperous or fortunate.
अधि-श्रय, अस्, m. a receptacle.

अधि-श्रयण, अम्, n. act or ceremony of putting
(a kettle) on the fire; (ई), f. a fire-place, oven.
—अधि-श्रयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or con-
nected with the Adhi-śrayaṇa.
अधि-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, put on the fire (as a pot).

अधिषवण अधि-षवण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सु
with अधि), Ved. hand-press for extracting and strain-
ing the Soma juice; (अस्, आ, अम्), used for extracting
and straining the Soma juice.

अधिष्ठा अधि-ष्ठा (अधि-स्था), cl. 1. P. or
poet. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -ष्ठातुम्, to stand upon,
depend; to inhabit, abide; to be, stand; to super-
intend, govern; to step over or across; to overcome;
to ascend, mount.

अधि-ष्ठातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, superintending, presid-
ing, governing, tutelary; (आ), m. a ruler; especially
the supreme ruler, or Providence personified and
identified with one or another of the Hindū gods;
a chief; a protector.

अधि-ष्ठान, अम्, n. standing by, being at hand,
approach; standing or resting upon; a basis, base;
a wheel (as the basis of a car); a position, site, re-
sidence, abode, seat; a settlement, town; government,
authority, power, dominion; a precedent, rule; a
benediction.
—अधिष्ठान-शरीर, अम्, n. (in
Sāṅkhya phil.) a body which forms the medium
between the subtle and the gross body.

अधि-ष्ठायक, अस्, आ, अम्, governing, super-
intending, guarding.

अधि-ष्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, settled; inhabited; super-
intended; regulated; appointed; superintending.

अधिस्त्रि अधि-स्त्रि, ind. concerning a wo-
man or a wife.
—अधि-स्त्री, f. a superior or distin-
guished woman.
अधिहरि अधि-हरि, ind. concerning Hari.

अधीत, अस्, आ, अम्, attained; studied, read; well
read, learned.
—अधीत-वेद, अस्, m. one who has
studied the Vedas or whose studies are finished.

आ-धीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. reflected or meditated
upon; (अम्), n. the object or subject of one's thoughts,
anything intended or hoped for.
अधीति, इस्, f. perusal, study; Ved. desire, recollection.
अधीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, well read, proficient.

अधीतिन्; add — occupied with the study of the
Veda. studying the Vedas.

अधीयान, अस्, m. a student; one who goes over
the Veda either as a student or a teacher.

अधीक्ष् अधीक्ष् (अधि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. अधी-
क्षते, -क्षितुम्, to discover.

अधीन अधीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अधि), subject,
subservient (generally forming the last member of a
compound).
—अधीन-ता, f. or अधीन-त्व, अम्, n.
subjection, dependence.

अधीन; add — resting on, situated in or on, be-
longing to.
आधीन = अधीन, depending on (with loc.).

अधीर अ-धीर, अस्, आ, अम्, not fixed, move-
able; confused; deficient in calm self-command; ex-
cited, excitable; fitful, capricious; querulous; weak-
minded, foolish; (आ), f. lightning; a capricious or bel-
licose mistress.
—अधीर-ता, f. want of confidence.
अधी-वासस्, ind. over the garment.

अधीश अधीश (अधि-ईश), अस्, m. a lord,
a master over (others).

अधीश्वर (अधि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. a supreme lord or
king, an emperor; (among the Jainas) an Arhat.

अधीष्ट अधीष्ट (अधि-इष्ट), अस्, आ, अम्,
solicited, honorary; (अम्), n. solicitation; honorary
office.

आ-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being placed, being de-
posited.
—आधीयमान-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
heart applied or intent on.

आधिकारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अधि-कार), supreme,
superior, relating or belonging to anything or person
in authority; official, relating to any office or duty.

आधिक्य आधिक्य, अम्, n. (fr. अधिक), ex-
cess, abundance, superabundance, high degree, over-
weight, preponderance; superiority.

आधिपत्य आधिपत्य, अम्, n. (fr. अधि-पति),
supremacy, sovereignty, power.

आधिवेदनिक आधिवेदनिक, अम्, n. (fr. अधि-
वेदन), property, gifts &c. given to a first wife
upon marrying a second.
अधि-विज्ञान, अम्, n. the highest knowledge.

अधि-ष्ठेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be superintended or
governed.

अधि-सेनापति, इस्, m. ‘over-general,’ a com-
mander-in-chief.
अधि-हस्ति, ind. on an elephant.
